notes.title: Major Update: Missing Pieces Bug Fixed
notes.content:
Hi everyone,



Sorry for the delay on this fix. Today's update ensures the pieces load properly and the board is playable again.



Please update the game and try a new match. If anything still looks off, please let us know so we can follow up quickly.



Special thanks to ◉_◉ for sharing a community workaround guide that helped us confirm the solution.



Thanks for your support,

- Deep Green Games leam

notes.title: The BOT.VINNIK you’ve been waiting for is finally here!
notes.content:
Hello, comrades!

You may have noticed we’ve been radio silent for a while—but there’s a good reason: we’ve spent the last few years working on the most ambitious BOT.VINNIK project to date!

🎉 BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/

This new game is the culmination of everything we’ve learned from the previous titles in the series. Alongside a brand-new visual style, it features:


 A reworked scoring system

 Structured progression across lessons

 Multiple difficulty levels

 A growing platform powered by future DLCs

 And even a beginner mode for those who don’t know how the knight moves yet


Of course, BOT.VINNIK’s trademark sarcasm and brutal honesty are back and sharper than ever.

A free demo will be released soon — until then, check out the trailer and hit that Wishlist button to let BOT.VINNIK know you’re still worthy of being called "comrade."
(YouTube™ embed: “BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy – Reveal Trailer”)

Thanks for all the support over the years!
See you at the Academy.


Rodrigo & Eduardo
Deep Green Games

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42471489/084ddadab27a86a52411acd976da250f6fbedd38.png

notes.title: minor bug fixes
notes.content:
the game now remembers your settings
 fixed some intermitent glitches

notes.title: bugfixes
notes.content:
Fixed a Leaderboard bug that prevented the ingame leaderboard from displaying until both game modes were played
 Fixed en passant bug where the piece would not disappear after captured

notes.title: More puzzles!
notes.content:
Over 600 new puzzles have been added to the starting levels.
 Improved Puzzle Randomizer, which now takes previously played puzzles into account.

That means you can now play a lot more before repeating a single puzzle!

notes.title: First Major Update is here!
notes.content:
Relax mode added. Feel like "relaxing" a little? We got you covered with this less challenging new mode. This mode also includes its own leaderboard.
 In-game leaderboard: You don't have to leave the game to check how your score compares to other players.
 UI improvements: You can now select the piece while the opponent is still moving, so you don't lose precious time waiting (thanks Trin, for the feedback). We also added separate visual indicators for when the pill is available and for when the pill can be used. And the animations are now smoother.
 Minor bug fixes.
